% Cross-section area
\begin{equation}\label{eq:B1_A}
A(r) = r^2\,f(r),\ f(R_*) = 1,\ f(r\to\infty) \to f_{\max}
\end{equation}

% Magnetic flux conservation
\begin{equation}\label{eq:B1_Br}
A(r) B_r(r) = R_*^2 B_0 \Rightarrow B_r(r) = \frac{B_0 R_*^2}{A(r)} = \frac{B_0}{f(r)}(R_*/r)^2
\end{equation}

% Magneto-Hydrostatic Equilibrium (MHSE)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:B1_MHSE}
\boxed{\partial_r p + \rho g = -B_r^2\,\partial_r(\ln A)}
\end{equation}

% Kopp-Holzer 1976 expansion factor

f(r) = \frac{f_{\max}\,e^{(r-r_1)/\sigma} + f_1}{e^{(r-r_1)/\sigma} + 1},\ f_1 = 1 - (f_{\max}-1)e^{(R_*-r_1)/\sigma}
\end{equation}

% Alfvén-wave amplitude scaling (WKB result, see B2)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:B1_amp}
\delta v_{\perp}(r) \propto (\rho v_A A)^{-1/4}\ \text{(Jacques) or}\ (\rho v_A A)^{-1/2}\ \text{(Poynting)}
\end{equation}
